# Results {#sec-results .deo-results}

## Overview of cases

The eight included cases span 2014 to the present and come from Europe,
Indonesia, the United States and an international patient network (Table 3).
Four are mental-health citizen science projects, two are Indonesian citizen
health-data initiatives that arose during the COVID-19 pandemic, and two are
failures involving data from people in mental distress. Leading roles were held
by citizens who founded the initiative in two cases (LaporCovid-19 and the
Patient-Led Research Collaborative), shared between a university and
lived-experience co-researchers in one (CoAct), and held by institutions in the
remaining five. Evidence was strongest for the Patient-Led Research
Collaborative and LaporCovid-19, each documented in peer-reviewed articles, and
weakest for Youth-GEMS, which has not yet published results, and Samaritans
Radar, which is documented in grey literature and news.
